report: All three sisters agreed on a plan. C initially opposed A buying the house at a family discount and wanted B to get money from the estate. A wanted to buy the house with her husband; B wanted funds to start a dance studio. They agreed on this path: first an independent valuation of the house (C will coordinate), then agreement on shares, then if A buys, she pays full market value with B and C receiving their shares in cash. No family discount was agreed. A written summary was sent to all three, each confirmed they will keep it as reference, and all final terms still require all three sisters' agreement. Next steps: arrange the valuation and agree on shares. I made no legal decisions or financial moves.
